objective: Keep feature delivery aligned with current goals, approved scope, implementation evidence, and validation gates.

modelTiers.simple: Use the repo model policy simple tier.
modelTiers.medium: Use the repo model policy medium tier.
modelTiers.hard: Use the repo model policy hard tier.
modelTiers.arbiter: Use the repo model policy arbiter tier only for release-critical or contradictory results.

evalCommands.purpose: Verify bounded loop contract and implementation-loop ledger evidence before marking implementation complete.
Verify goal, traceability, drift, and validation freshness before final scoring.

successCriteria.description: Each implementation or validation loop records iteration evidence in loop-ledger.jsonl.
All configured evaluation commands pass before Gofer reports the feature complete.

stopConditions.description: Stop when all success criteria have evidence and no blocking loop findings remain.
Escalate instead of looping forever when the same failing action reaches maxIterations.

escalateWhen: the same failure repeats at maxIterations
a security, privacy, data, or release-critical gate remains red
budget or context-window limits would hide evidence
